raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: cadCAD
  version: "0.4.28"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/cadCAD-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: a411f124977219d1f765164544fef0cab92601e895d687706516b8dd2d5f367f

build:
  number: 3
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools
  run:
    - dill
    - fn
    - funcy
    - numpy
    - pandas
    - pathos
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - pytz
    - six

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - cadCAD
        - documentation
        - simulations
        - testing
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}
        - "*"

about:
  summary: "cadCAD: a differential games based simulation software package for research, validation, and Computer Aided Design of economic systems"
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  homepage: https://github.com/cadCAD-org/cadCAD

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jan-janssen
